aboutGame.title: What Is Predictive Victory Dynamics?
paragraphs: Predictive Victory Dynamics is the limited-time betting event of Genshin Impact Version 7.1 by HoYoverse — sixteen pre-built character teams enter a Round of 16 knockout bracket played out across eight daily rounds of auto-resolved battles. You never control the fighters: your game is prediction, wagering Victory Emblems on each match's winner before the simulation resolves and earning rewards that scale with how accurately you call the bracket.

This wiki is the fan-built companion to the event: daily predictions with reasoning, the full bracket and team profiles, the wagering mechanics, the scoring and payout system, the complete reward list and the bankroll strategy that ties it all together. No account power required — prediction skill is the only currency.

items.question: What is Predictive Victory Dynamics?
items.answer: The limited-time betting event of Genshin Impact Version 7.1 — sixteen teams play a Round of 16 knockout bracket across eight daily rounds of auto-resolved battles, and you wager Victory Emblems on each match's winner for rewards that scale with your prediction accuracy.

items.question: Is Predictive Victory Dynamics free?
items.answer: Yes — the event is fully in-game and free. Victory Emblems are event currency with no real-money path, and no team building is required: the sixteen rosters are fixed, so prediction skill is all that matters.

items.question: What happens if I miss a day?
items.answer: That day's prediction payouts and daily task Emblem top-up are permanently missed — the bracket continues without you and there is no retroactive window. Resume the next day; the late rounds still carry the largest payouts.

items.question: How do rewards work?
items.answer: Two streams: per-round payouts settle automatically after each daily resolve, and a final conversion turns your Emblem total and accuracy record into tiered rewards — Primogems, Mora and materials — that must be claimed before the event page closes.
